ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface; minimal high-intensity skin pigmentation, with high-intensity pixels localized to barnacle clusters at the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity mapping across the observable fluke area; absence of distinct high-contrast contiguous geometric pigmentation blobs on the skin surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central junction between lobes, characterized by a sharp convergence with moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the trailing edge of the right lobe; the left lobe trailing edge appears smoother with less pronounced pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe displays a convex outer sweep towards the distal tip; the left lobe shows an upward, linear trajectory terminating in a clustered tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and along the leading superior margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; secondary irregularity and jaggedness on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive and dense accumulation of barnacle clusters on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke.
